To evaluate the credit rating of this issuer:

The issuer shows solid profitability with an operating margin of 20% (operating income of 436M on 2,153M revenue) and positive net income of 242M, which supports its debt-servicing capacity. However, its balance sheet displays high leverage with a total debt-to-equity posture (liabilities of 7,452M against equity of 3,858M) and weak short-term liquidity, as evidenced by a current ratio of 0.72 (current assets of 674M versus current liabilities of 932M). This combination of strong operating performance alongside moderate-to-high leverage and tight liquidity is characteristic of an investment-grade rating at the lower end of the spectrum.

DECISION: BBB-
